about.label: About Me
about.bio_01_text: From childhood — heart surgeries, clinical deaths, work in intensive care and a morgue. My understanding of the boundary between worlds was forged not by books, but by my own body.
about.bio_02_text: Despite the complexity of ritual work, I am distinguished by an ecological approach: if a client is uncomfortable working with certain energies — the ritual architecture changes, without losing its power.
about.bio_03_text: I don't sell vague promises or play at mystique. My method is uncompromising honesty, where mysticism is inseparably linked with anatomy, physics and ancient heritage.

about.title: About Me
about.label: About Me
about.bio_01_text: I'm 24, from the Donetsk region — I grew up between the world of people and the world of nature, in a family where traditions and rituals were ordinary, and Greek myths replaced bedtime stories. Through medicine, serious heart surgeries and my own experience on the edge of life and death, I came to the final acceptance of my path — and to the family grimoires inherited after my stepfather's death.
about.bio_02_text: I cannot name the moment I came to magic — it has accompanied me all my life. The foundation of my worldview is paganism: the Greek tradition, the cult of the Great Mother and Hecate — archetype of the guide between worlds and keeper of crossroads. I'm often called a necromancer, but first and foremost I am a pagan and a practitioner studying the laws of existence.
about.bio_03_text: For me, the world is a multi-layered system of archetypes, elements and cycles, far broader than the material. Humans are not free from the influences of lineage, psyche and circumstance — but awareness expands the space of choice. The soul is experience passing through transformations, and life is the opportunity to know oneself.
about.bio_04_text: Death was never an abstraction for me — personal experience and work in medicine showed it from different sides. I see it not as an end, but as part of the great cycle of renewal: not just loss, but transformation that reminds us of the value of time and life itself.
about.bio_05_text: Power is not dominion over others, but the ability to consciously influence one's own life and understand the causes of what happens. In itself it is neither good nor evil — everything depends on the level of awareness of the one who uses it. That is why I place understanding above power.
about.bio_06_text: I don't solve other people's problems instead of the client — I help see the situation more deeply and notice patterns the person may have missed. Any change begins with the person's own inner readiness, and I respect that freedom of choice.
about.bio_07_text: Energy exchange is a natural part of any interaction: free help does not exist, we always pay — with money, time or attention. For me, payment is a form of recognition of the value of labour and experience, not an end in itself.
about.bio_08_text: A true practitioner must understand the world from different angles — which is why alongside spiritual knowledge I always maintain a scientific approach: medical education helps separate real processes from illusions. I continue to learn — from religious studies to clinical psychology, because learning for me is not the accumulation of information, but a deepening of the understanding of the human being.
